claim.value: Independently dated records and overlapping histories, if available, are proposed as references for the comparison.
claim.scope: Reference selection; their availability is to be identified, not assumed established.

provenance.rationale: P004 identifies both reference types and restricts selection to those available.

signal_basis.value: Candidate placements are checked against independently supported dates and additional histories; the favorable signal is repeated distinctive agreement across overlapping records that respects independent anchors and holds against histories unused in selecting the alignment.
signal_basis.scope: A prospective comparison and validation procedure, assumed here to yield the described signal; it does not establish that references are already available.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans specify the reference checks, favorable alignment signal and prospective status; P004 connects these checks to the proposed reference selection.
The bounded reference-selection proposal is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim proposes suitable comparison references conditionally on availability. Independently supported dates and overlapping histories directly serve the described alignment checks. It asserts neither their actual availability nor their infallibility, so the operation licenses this limited proposal.
uncertainty: Actual reference availability remains unestablished, as the claim explicitly acknowledges.
